pull.title: BIP375: check SegWit versions in non-witness UTXOs
pull.body:
BIP375 requires constructors and signers to reject PSBTs that combine silent payment outputs with inputs spending SegWit v2+ outputs.

The reference validator currently performs this check only when the prevout is provided through `PSBT_IN_WITNESS_UTXO`. BIP174 also permits SegWit inputs to provide the full previous transaction through `PSBT_IN_NON_WITNESS_UTXO`, so an input containing only that field can currently bypass the SegWit-version check.

Reuse the existing `_script_pubkey_from_psbt_input()` helper when validating input eligibility. This extracts the referenced scriptPubKey from either UTXO field.

Also add an invalid test vector containing:

- a silent payment output;
- a SegWit v2 prevout supplied only through `PSBT_IN_NON_WITNESS_UTXO`;
- a matching previous transaction ID and output index.

events.body: @achow101  @andrewtoth Could you please take a look when you have a chance? Thanks!

The validator change holds: at ea1192c98800f3157fa6b22307e608362a07b7d2, master (927b6de) accepts the new vector under `input_eligibility`, this branch rejects it with "Input 0 uses segwit version > 1 with silent payments", and all 43 vectors pass.

The vector's PSBT_IN_PREVIOUS_TXID is byte-reversed. The field holds `9630266b…0c73c9`; the double-SHA256 of the PSBT_IN_NON_WITNESS_UTXO transaction is `c9730c1b…263096`. BIP 174 requires the two to match ("its hash must match the hash specified in the prevout"), and the six existing vectors with a non-witness UTXO store the hash as computed, so a parser that checks this rejects the PSBT for the wrong reason. Reversing the 32 bytes of PSBT_IN_PREVIOUS_TXID, and of `prevout_txid` in `supplementary` to match the other vectors, fixes it.

comments.body:
Thanks, good catch. I had written the human-readable txid byte order directly into PSBT_IN_PREVIOUS_TXID.

I updated the field to use the raw double-SHA256 byte order and changed the supplementary prevout_txid accordingly. I also checked all seven vectors containing PSBT_IN_NON_WITNESS_UTXO; their previous transaction hashes now match their PSBT_IN_PREVIOUS_TXID fields.

The corrected vector is still rejected by input eligibility with:

Input 0 uses segwit version > 1 with silent payments
Updated the supplementary prevout_txid to match the serialized hash as well. Please review it again.
